aliases: Applied Digital Ellendale AI data center
Applied Digital North Dakota AI campus
status_as_of_cutoff: Applied Digital reports Polaris Forge 1 has 175 MW of live operational AI capacity as of 2026-06-30/2026-07-01 after Ready for Service for Phase 1 of Building 2, following the first 100 MW building becoming operational in October 2025. Official Dickey County and North Dakota records continue to show remaining expansion/construction and permitting activity: March 2025 county minutes described ten operational buildings, a 380,000-square-foot building under construction, and dirt work for two 900,000-square-foot buildings; the governor's 2025-03-19 release described the HPC expansion and housing as under construction; April 2026 county minutes described additional summer workforce and state-approved workforce housing; PSC case PU-26-173 advanced from temporary/permanent electric-service filings for an Applied Digital man camp to a 2026-07-27 order; and NDDEQ posted draft/permit-to-construct materials for the ELN backup generation plant. No independent government CO, data-center energization register, or building-by-building commissioning record was located.
evidence_grade: B - live capacity is from owner public-company releases/earnings materials; official county, governor, PSC, and NDDEQ records corroborate location, construction, workforce, utility-service, and backup-generation permitting, but not full building-by-building data-center energization.

actions.result_status: Trade reporting identifies September 2022 as the start of Polaris Forge 1 construction. No original permit or government groundbreaking record was located in the reviewed pass.
actions.access_caveat: Specialist trade report; date is not independently verified by a retrieved building record.
actions.evidence_note: Construction history explicitly labeled trade evidence.

actions.result_status: County minutes record Applied Digital representatives reporting ten operational buildings, one 380,000-square-foot building still under construction, and dirt work started on two additional buildings estimated at 900,000 square feet each.
actions.access_caveat: Local minutes record a project update, not a permit closeout or utility energization certificate.

actions.government_body: Office of the Governor of North Dakota
actions.result_status: Governor Armstrong and state/local officials inspected Applied Digital's Ellendale HPC expansion and related housing project, both described as under construction. The release describes a current 380,000-square-foot HPC facility and two planned 900,000-square-foot expansions.
actions.access_caveat: Inspection is not a CO, energization, commissioning, or live-service record.

actions.result_status: County minutes record an Applied Digital representative reporting 400-600 additional summer employees, workforce housing south of the highway across from Pheasant Lake expected to be operational on 2026-06-01, and worker bussing from housing to the Applied Digital site.
actions.access_caveat: Workforce/housing update does not prove data-center energization or commissioned IT load.

actions.government_body: North Dakota Industrial Commission / Transmission Authority
actions.result_status: The state study lists Applied Digital Ellendale data-center scenarios at 100 MW (2025), 150 MW (2026), and 150 MW (2027), while also listing an in-service 180 MW blockchain facility. These are planning scenarios, not measured IT load or energization proof.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: 2025 Future-Proofing North Dakota's Electrical Capacity Study
actions.access_caveat: State study values use different phase/load definitions and are not a permit or utility service certificate.
actions.evidence_note: Official utility/planning context; phase values preserved without normalization.

actions.government_body: North Dakota Public Service Commission / Montana-Dakota Utilities
actions.result_status: MDU filed PU-26-173 seeking authority to provide permanent electric service to an Applied Digital man camp near Ellendale; the PSC case page later lists a 2026-07-27 order in the docket. The service is for the man camp, not the data-center buildings.
actions.access_caveat: The filing and docket concern the man camp and do not establish the HPC buildings' delivered load.

actions.government_body: North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality
actions.result_status: NDDEQ posted a notice of intent to issue an air-pollution-control Permit to Construct for Applied Digital Corporation's Ellendale backup-power generation plant.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: NDDEQ public notice ID 4034; permit number not exposed in search result
actions.access_caveat: Notice of intent is not the final permit, operation, energization, or commissioning record.

actions.result_status: Applied Digital announced Ready for Service for Phase 1 of Building 2 at Polaris Forge 1, delivering 75 MW of operational AI capacity and bringing campus live capacity to 175 MW; it also stated full buildout is contracted at 400 MW of critical IT load.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; no independent government CO/energization record was located.
actions.evidence_note: Primary owner evidence for live capacity.

actions.result_status: Trade reporting says Applied Digital completed the first phase of the second building at the Ellendale AI/HPC campus, delivering 75 MW to CoreWeave and bringing total live capacity to 175 MW; full buildout is described as 400 MW contracted critical IT load.
actions.access_caveat: Specialist trade report; title shorthand says second building, while the article body and company source specify Phase 1 of Building 2.
actions.evidence_note: Trade corroboration of owner live-capacity claim.

actions.result_status: Applied Digital reported that the first 100 MW data center at Polaris Forge 1 became operational in October 2025 and that Phase 1 of Building 2, 75 MW, was delivered on 2026-06-30, bringing total live campus capacity to 175 MW; it said additional Polaris Forge 1 buildings are in various construction stages.
actions.access_caveat: Company financial release; useful for capacity/status timing but not an official government energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Primary owner timing detail for first 100 MW operational and Building 2 Phase 1 delivery.

actions.result_status: PSC case PU-26-173 docket lists a Commission motion to adopt an order and an order filed on 2026-07-27 for the Applied Digital Man Camp - Ellendale public convenience and necessity case.
actions.access_caveat: Docket entry establishes case progression for man-camp electric service, not data-center building energization.

capacity_context.metric: live operational AI capacity reported by owner
capacity_context.caveat: 175 MW live and 400 MW contracted/full-buildout are owner-reported critical/AI capacity figures; no government energization or CO record was located.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.description: DCD headline says Applied Digital completed the second building, but the article body and Applied Digital primary release specify Ready for Service for Phase 1 of Building 2, delivering 75 MW. Treat Building 2 full 150 MW completion as not independently established in this refresh.

history.previous_value: Applied Digital's Ellendale HPC expansion is supported by official North Dakota inspection and utility/environmental records. The governor's 2025-03-19 release says the 380,000-square-foot HPC facility was under construction and expected to begin operations late that year, followed by two 900,000-square-foot expansions. A 2026-06-15 state notice concerns an air permit to construct the backup-power plant, and a 2026-06-11 MDU PSC filing concerns permanent service to an Applied Digital man camp. Trade reporting says a second building was complete on 2026-07-02. No complete building-by-building CO/energization/commissioning register was located.
history.new_value: partial live with 175 MW owner-reported live operational AI capacity, while remaining expansion/construction and permitting continue
